sources.title: A Cyclic Cosmological Model in the Landscape Scenario

evidence.text: Can decay of a metastable de Sitter vacuum in a toy string landscape lead to contraction inside the decay bubble and, with an assumed singularity-avoiding modification, repeated cosmological cycles?

sources.title: Lorentzian vacuum transitions for anisotropic universes

evidence.text: How can Lorentzian Wheeler–DeWitt tunneling methods compute scalar-vacuum transition probabilities in homogeneous anisotropic universes, and how does anisotropy affect those probabilities?

sources.title: Comments on the Transplanckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: If de Sitter stationary points are absent, can rolling dark energy coexist with a landscape of negative-energy endpoints and a short TCC lifetime? The paper adopts this setting to test compatibility, without constructing the underlying string states.

sources.title: The Stabilizing Effect of Gravity Made Simple

evidence.text: How can a field-space variational formulation explain gravitational stabilization and quenching of Minkowski or AdS false-vacuum decay, characterize critical domain walls, and approximate near-critical decays beyond the thin-wall limit?
